findings.summary: Initial orchestration persisted a future_model proposal and visible reasoning-turn audit in separate transactions, so an audit write failure could leave an orphan pending model proposal.
findings.repair: Added createModelProposalWithinTx and made proposal creation, proposal-created event, reasoning-turn audit and provider-reference update one short post-provider transaction.

findings.summary: The first runtime-policy exception checked globally enabled external actions before the reasoning special case, so an accidental main-API caller could have obtained outreach_reasoning permission in active mode.
findings.repair: outreach_reasoning is now evaluated first and is allowed only for serviceName=engagement-api with both Phase 2 state and Phase 3 reasoning flags enabled, regardless of global external-action mode.

findings.summary: Initial reasoning turn lease was 3 minutes, shorter than the bounded maximum multi-round provider window, allowing a still-live turn to be reclaimed concurrently.
findings.repair: Turn lease increased to 15 minutes, beyond six 90-second provider rounds plus bounded tool execution; stale crashed turns still recover deterministically.

findings.summary: A multi-client or no-client Campaign Spec initially produced no single clientScope, which could let client-oriented read tools request other otherwise-authorized tenant clients unrelated to the campaign.
findings.repair: The reasoning context now derives the explicit sponsor-client allowlist from Campaign Spec. No-client campaigns receive no client-tool surface; multi-client/coalition tool results must resolve to one of the explicit sponsor client refs. No primary client is invented.

findings.summary: Archiving a conversation during an in-flight provider call could leave the server turn claim uncleared because archived conversation rows were fully immutable.
findings.repair: A follow-up migration allows archived rows only the narrow claim-clearing update while retaining identity/provider/state immutability.

findings.summary: Capiro-managed continuity could feed prior turns back to the model but had no owner-scoped read route for reconstructing visible conversation history after product reload.
findings.repair: Added bounded owner-scoped visible turn history service and GET route; provider-state mode returns null for message bodies Capiro did not retain.

findings.summary: Reasoning needed OpenAI access in engagement-api shadow mode but enabling the global external-action switch would also enable send/OAuth/other unsafe actions.
findings.repair: Added a narrow outreach_reasoning runtime action and reasoning-specific credential resolver method; every unrelated external action remains blocked in shadow mode.

findings.summary: The first reasoning gate could be enabled independently of the Phase 2 canonical state API, allowing a rollout to expose the model while the state substrate remained dark.
findings.repair: The reasoning HTTP guard and the reasoning-only outbound runtime permission now both require OUTREACH_V3_STATE_ENABLED=true and OUTREACH_V3_REASONING_ENABLED=true. The route manifest records the Phase 2 state prerequisite.

findings.summary: A model turn returning no commands could initially commit and return visible advice even if Campaign Spec changed while the provider call was running, because only proposal creation enforced expectedStateVersion.
findings.repair: Added a read-only Phase 2 state-version guard and require the exact inspected version before every successful reasoning-turn commit, including no-command responses. State drift becomes a retryable 409 with no success audit.

findings.summary: The stateless store=false Responses tool loop replayed provider output items but did not explicitly request encrypted reasoning content, creating a continuity gap for reasoning-model tool rounds under manual context management.
findings.repair: For reasoning models with store=false, the provider now requests include=[reasoning.encrypted_content] and replays the returned opaque reasoning item with provider output plus function_call_output only within the same in-flight turn. Encrypted reasoning is never persisted, logged, returned, or used as Campaign State.
findings.reference: Current OpenAI Responses guidance for store=false/manual context reasoning continuity

findings.summary: Initial web-isolation architecture verifier scanned .ts but not React .tsx files, where a premature reasoning UI dependency would most likely appear.
findings.repair: Production-source scan now includes .ts and .tsx while excluding tests/specs.

findings.summary: Initial raw-HTTP provider tests used the SDK-only output_text convenience property rather than the raw Responses API output message shape.
findings.repair: Provider tests now parse output[].message.content[].output_text, matching the raw HTTPS API response contract.

ownerWaivers.summary: Owner chose to skip Clerk-authenticated live Phase 2 route verification after JWT acquisition remained blocked. The affected scenarios are NOT_EXECUTED and must not be represented as PASS.

prerequisiteBlockers.summary: The exact Phase 2 code SHA consumed by this branch was deployed dark and owner-accepted with Clerk-authenticated live acceptance explicitly waived. No Phase 2 code/schema reconciliation is required. A fresh independent Phase 2 approval marker remains pending unless separately waived.

notes: No Phase 3 deployment, shared-database migration, UI change, merge, or PR creation has been performed.
No finding was closed by granting direct model state mutation or broadening the external-action switch.
OpenAI provider state is off by default; capiro_managed + store=false is the default retention posture.
Encrypted provider reasoning used for store=false tool-loop continuity is transient only and never persisted or returned.
No hidden chain-of-thought field exists in Phase 3 persistence or API contracts.
The deployed Phase 2 SHA exactly equals this branch's Phase 2 base SHA.
